passages.title: 送錯的生日邀請卡
passages.text: Amy wanted to {1} her best friends to her birthday party. She wrote ten cards and asked her little brother to put them in her classmates' mailboxes. But he put them in the {2} mailboxes. On Saturday, Amy waited at home {3} three o'clock, but none of her friends came. Then the doorbell rang. Ten old people from the next street stood at the door with gifts! "We {4} you don't mind," one grandma said. "We all love parties." Amy laughed and let them in. They {5} the whole afternoon singing songs and eating cake. It was the strangest party ever, but Amy was very happy. Now she has ten new grandparents, and her friends are coming next week.

blanks.why: invite + 人 + to + 活動「邀請某人參加…」。spend、hit、hear her friends to her party 都不通。
the wrong mailboxes「錯的信箱」：弟弟放錯了信箱，所以朋友沒來。least、likely、kind 都不能這樣形容信箱。
wait until + 時間「一直等到…」。whether、than、during 後面不能這樣接 three o'clock。
We hope (that) …「我們希望…」：希望你不介意。spend、hit、choose 後面不能接這樣的句子。
spend + 時間 + V-ing「花時間做…」：他們整個下午都在唱歌吃蛋糕。hit、heard、invited the whole afternoon 都不通。

passages.zh: Amy 想邀請好朋友來參加她的生日派對。她寫了十張卡片，請弟弟幫忙放進同學的信箱。但弟弟放錯了信箱。星期六，Amy 在家一直等到三點，卻沒有一個朋友來。這時門鈴響了，十位住在隔壁街的老人家拿著禮物站在門口！「希望你不介意，」一位奶奶說，「我們都很愛派對。」Amy 笑著讓他們進門。他們整個下午都在唱歌、吃蛋糕。這是史上最奇怪的派對，但 Amy 非常開心。現在她多了十個新的爺爺奶奶，而她的朋友們下星期會來。

passages.title: 打破窗戶的全壘打
passages.text: Last Sunday, my cousin and I played baseball in the park. I {1} the ball so hard that it flew over the trees. Then we {2} a loud sound. It was glass breaking! We ran over and saw a broken window. "We should not play here," my cousin said. "We chose the {3} place." An old man came out of the house. We were scared, but we decided to tell the truth. "We are sorry. We will pay for the window," I said. To our surprise, he smiled. "I always {4} someone would play baseball here again. My son used to play in this park when he was a boy." Then he {5} us into his house and showed us his son's old baseball gloves. Now we visit him every Sunday.

blanks.why: hit the ball「擊球」：球被打得飛過樹頂。heard、hoped、invited the ball 都不通。
hear a sound「聽到聲音」：玻璃破掉的聲音。hit、spent、chose a loud sound 都不通。
the wrong place「錯的地方」：我們選錯了打球的地方。the least place 不通；likely 不能這樣用；every 前面不能加 the。
hope (that) …「希望…」：老爺爺一直希望有人再來這裡打棒球。hit、spent、invited 後面不能接句子。
invite + 人 + into + 地方「邀請某人進去」。hoped、heard、spent us into his house 都不通。

passages.zh: 上星期天，我和表哥在公園打棒球。我把球打得好用力，球飛過了樹頂。接著我們聽到一個很大的聲音——是玻璃破掉的聲音！我們跑過去，看到一扇破掉的窗戶。「我們不該在這裡打球的，」表哥說，「我們選錯地方了。」一位老爺爺從屋裡走出來。我們很害怕，但還是決定說實話。「對不起，我們會賠窗戶的錢。」我說。沒想到他笑了：「我一直希望有人能再來這裡打棒球。我兒子小時候就常在這個公園打球。」接著他邀請我們進屋，給我們看他兒子以前的棒球手套。現在我們每個星期天都會去看他。

passages.title: 選社團的煩惱
passages.text: At our school, every student has to {1} a club. I couldn't decide {2} to join the dance club or the science club. I love dancing, but my best friend Ben was in the science club. I asked my sister for help. "Don't just follow your friends," she said. "Ask yourself how you want to {3} your time." So I visited both clubs. In the science club, the students were making small rockets. It was fun, but it was not for me. Then I walked to the dance room. Before I even opened the door, I {4} the music, and my feet started to move. I joined the dance club. Ben and I are not in the same club now, but at {5} we still eat lunch together every day.

blanks.why: choose a club「選一個社團」。spend、hit、hear a club 都不通。
decide whether to … or …「決定要…還是…」。until、than、because 後面不能接 to + 原形動詞。
spend your time「花你的時間」。hit、hope、invite your time 都不通。
hear the music「聽到音樂」：還沒開門就聽到音樂。hit、invited、spent the music 都不通。
at least「至少」：雖然不同社團，至少還能一起吃午餐。at lot、at few、at same 都不是片語。

passages.zh: 在我們學校，每個學生都要選一個社團。我不知道要參加舞蹈社還是科學社。我很愛跳舞，但我最好的朋友 Ben 在科學社。我請姊姊幫忙。「不要只是跟著朋友走，」她說，「問問自己想怎麼花你的時間。」於是我兩個社團都去看了。在科學社，同學們正在做小火箭，很好玩，但不適合我。接著我走到舞蹈教室，還沒開門就聽到了音樂，我的腳就開始動了起來。我參加了舞蹈社。現在我和 Ben 不在同一個社團，但至少我們每天還是一起吃午餐。

passages.title: 颱風夜停電了
passages.text: A strong typhoon {1} Taiwan last night. The wind was so loud that we could {2} the trees shaking outside. At about nine o'clock, the lights went out. My little sister started to cry. Dad found some candles and said, "Let's play a game {3} the lights come back." We played cards and told stories by the candlelight. Mom made hot noodles on the gas stove. Dad lost every game. "I think these cards are {4}," he said, and we all laughed. At midnight, the lights came back on. But my sister didn't want to stop playing. "I {5} the lights go out again tomorrow!" she said.

blanks.why: A typhoon hit Taiwan.「颱風侵襲台灣」，hit 也可以指天災「侵襲」。heard、chose、invited Taiwan 都不通。
hear + 受詞 + V-ing「聽到…正在…」：聽到樹在外面搖晃。spend、invite、choose 都不通。
until + 句子「直到…」：玩遊戲直到電來。whether、than、during 都不合句意或文法。
be wrong「有問題、不對」：爸爸開玩笑說牌有問題。least、likely、few 都不能這樣形容牌。
I hope (that) …「我希望…」。spend、hit、invite 後面不能接句子。

passages.zh: 昨晚有個強颱侵襲台灣。風聲大到我們可以聽到外面的樹在搖晃。大約九點時，停電了。妹妹開始哭。爸爸找到一些蠟燭，說：「我們來玩遊戲，一直玩到電來。」我們在燭光下玩牌、說故事，媽媽用瓦斯爐煮了熱騰騰的麵。爸爸每一局都輸。「我覺得這副牌有問題。」他說，我們全都笑了。半夜電來了，但妹妹不想停下來。「我希望明天再停電一次！」她說。

passages.title: 園遊會花光零用錢
passages.text: Before the school fair, Dad gave me 500 dollars. "{1} it carefully," he said. But the food at the fair looked so good. I bought fried chicken, bubble tea, and cotton candy. Then I played a ball game. I had to {2} three cans with a ball to win a big teddy bear. I tried five times, but I couldn't do it. I didn't know my money was almost gone {3} I opened my wallet. There were only twenty dollars left! My friend Kelly {4} about my problem and shared her lunch with me. "Next time, make a plan first," she said. She was right. I didn't get the bear, but at {5} I learned an important lesson.

blanks.why: spend money「花錢」：爸爸要我小心花錢。hit、hear、invite it 都不合句意。
hit the cans「打中罐子」：用球打倒罐子才能贏熊。hear、hope、invite three cans 都不通。
not … until …「直到…才…」：打開錢包才知道錢快花光了。whether、than、during 都不通。
hear about …「聽說…」。hit、spent、chose about 都不通。
at least「至少」：沒拿到熊，至少學到教訓。at lot、at few、at same 都不是片語。

passages.zh: 園遊會前，爸爸給了我 500 元。「小心花。」他說。但園遊會的食物看起來都好好吃。我買了炸雞、珍奶和棉花糖。接著我去玩丟球遊戲，要用球打中三個罐子才能贏一隻大泰迪熊。我試了五次都沒成功。直到打開錢包，我才知道錢快花光了，只剩二十元！朋友 Kelly 聽說了我的狀況，把她的午餐分給我。「下次先做好計畫吧。」她說。她說得對。我雖然沒拿到熊，但至少學到了重要的一課。

passages.title: 打錯的電話
passages.text: One evening, my phone rang. "Hi, Grandma! It's me, Tommy!" a little boy said. "I'm sorry. You called the {1} number," I said. "Oh," he said sadly. "I wanted to {2} my grandma to my school play tomorrow. But I lost her new number." I could {3} that he was going to cry. So I {4} to help him. I asked for his grandma's name and the name of her street. Then I called my aunt, who lives on the same street. She knew his grandma! The next day, my aunt took the old woman to the school. Later, Tommy's teacher told my aunt that Tommy smiled from the beginning {5} the end of the play.

blanks.why: call the wrong number「打錯電話」。least、likely、kind 都不能形容號碼。
invite + 人 + to + 活動「邀請某人參加…」。spend、hit、hear my grandma to my play 都不通。
hear that …「聽得出…」：從聲音聽得出他快哭了。hit、spend、choose that 都不通。
choose to + 原形動詞「選擇、決定做…」。hit、heard、spent 後面不能接 to help。
from … until …「從…一直到…」：從頭笑到尾。whether、than、because 都不能這樣用。

passages.zh: 有天晚上，我的手機響了。「奶奶好！是我，Tommy！」一個小男孩說。「不好意思，你打錯電話了。」我說。「喔……」他難過地說，「我想邀請奶奶來看我明天的學校話劇，可是我弄丟了她的新號碼。」我聽得出他快哭了，所以我選擇幫他。我問了他奶奶的名字和住的街名，然後打給住在同一條街的阿姨。她認識他奶奶！隔天，阿姨帶著老奶奶去了學校。後來，Tommy 的老師告訴阿姨，Tommy 從話劇開始一直笑到結束。

passages.title: 大雄的記憶吐司
passages.text: Nobita had a big math test on Monday, but he {1} the whole weekend playing video games. On Sunday night, he cried to Doraemon. "I {2} you have something to help me!" Doraemon took out some special bread. "Put this bread on your book, and then eat it. You will remember everything on the page." Nobita ate twenty pages and was too full to eat any more. In the test the next day, he answered the first twenty questions right. But he got the last ten {3}. After school, Doraemon asked {4} he had studied at all before Sunday. "Not even for one minute," Nobita said. "Then you should be happy you got at {5} twenty right!" said Doraemon.

blanks.why: spend + 時間 + V-ing「花時間做…」：整個週末都在打電動。hit、heard、invited the whole weekend 都不通。
I hope (that) …「我希望…」。hit、spend、invite 後面不能接句子。
get … wrong「把…答錯」，和前面 answered … right 相對。least、likely、kind 都不通。
ask whether …「問是否…」：問他星期天之前有沒有讀書。until、than、because 都不能接在 asked 後面表示「問…」。
at least「至少」：至少答對二十題。at lot、at few、at same 都不是片語。

passages.zh: 大雄星期一有一個重要的數學考試，但他整個週末都在打電動。星期天晚上，他哭著找哆啦A夢：「希望你有東西可以幫我！」哆啦A夢拿出一種特別的吐司：「把吐司蓋在書上，再吃掉，你就會記住那一頁的所有內容。」大雄吃了二十頁，撐得再也吃不下了。隔天考試，他前二十題都答對了，但最後十題全錯。放學後，哆啦A夢問他星期天之前到底有沒有讀書。「連一分鐘都沒有。」大雄說。「那你至少答對二十題，應該要高興了！」哆啦A夢說。

passages.title: 校外教學去哪裡
passages.text: Our class had to {1} a place for our school trip. Some students wanted to go to the zoo. Others wanted to go to an amusement park. We talked about it {2} the bell rang, but we still couldn't agree. Our teacher said, "Let's vote. But first, think about the cost. Each of you can't {3} more than 800 dollars." The amusement park was too expensive, so the zoo won. A week before the trip, we {4} that a baby panda was just born at the zoo. Everyone was excited. On the trip day, we ran to see it first. It was sleeping the whole time, but it was the cutest thing we had ever seen. "I {5} we can come back when it is bigger," my friend said.

blanks.why: choose a place「選一個地方」。hit、hear、spend a place 都不通。
until + 句子「一直到…」：一直討論到鐘響。whether、than、during 都不通。
spend + 錢「花錢」：每人不能花超過 800 元。hit、hear、invite 800 dollars 都不通。
hear that …「聽說…」：聽說動物園剛生了小貓熊。hit、chose、invited that 都不通。
I hope (that) …「希望…」。spend、hit、invite 後面不能接句子。

passages.zh: 我們班要選一個校外教學的地點。有些同學想去動物園，有些想去遊樂園。我們一直討論到鐘響，還是無法達成共識。老師說：「我們來投票吧。不過先想想費用，每個人不能花超過 800 元。」遊樂園太貴了，所以動物園勝出。出發前一個星期，我們聽說動物園剛生了一隻貓熊寶寶，大家都好興奮。校外教學那天，我們第一個就跑去看牠。牠從頭到尾都在睡覺，卻是我們看過最可愛的東西。「希望等牠長大一點，我們還能再來。」我朋友說。

passages.title: 開學第一天走錯教室
passages.text: On the first day of junior high, I was very nervous. I walked into a classroom and sat down. When the teacher came in, she started to talk about the Comprehensive Assessment Program. The CAP? That's a test for ninth graders! Something was {1}. Then I {2} the teacher say, "Welcome, ninth graders!" I was not sure {3} I should stand up and leave. My face turned red, and I {4} nobody would notice me. But the teacher smiled and asked, "Are you a new seventh grader? Your classroom is on the first floor." Everyone laughed, but in a kind way. A tall girl even walked me to my classroom. Now she is my good friend, and she often {5} me to her basketball games.

blanks.why: Something is wrong.「有地方不對勁。」least、few、every 都不能放在 was 後面這樣用。
hear + 人 + 原形動詞「聽到某人說…」。hit、spent、invited the teacher say 都不通。
be not sure whether …「不確定是否…」。until、than、during 都不通。
hope (that) …「希望…」：希望沒人注意到我。hit、spent、invited 後面不能接句子。
invite + 人 + to + 活動「邀請某人來…」。hits、hears、spends me to her games 都不通。

gloss: 國中教育會考（簡稱 CAP）
passages.zh: 國中開學第一天，我非常緊張。我走進一間教室坐了下來。老師進來後，開始講國中教育會考。會考？那是九年級的考試耶！一定有哪裡不對勁。接著我聽到老師說：「歡迎各位九年級同學！」我不確定該不該站起來離開。我的臉都紅了，只希望沒人注意到我。但老師笑著問：「你是新的七年級生嗎？你的教室在一樓喔。」大家都笑了，但很友善。一位高個子的女生甚至陪我走到教室。現在她是我的好朋友，還常邀請我去看她的籃球比賽。

passages.title: 棒球隊唯一的女生
passages.text: Mia is the only girl on the school baseball team. At first, she couldn't {1} the ball at all. Some boys laughed at her. "Baseball is not for girls," they said. Mia didn't listen to them. She practiced every day after school {2} it got dark. She even {3} all her pocket money on a new bat. In the final game, our team was losing 2 to 3. It was Mia's turn. Everyone {4} she could do something. Mia sent the ball over the fence, and our team won the game! The boys who laughed at her were the first to run to her. "We were {5} about you," they said.

blanks.why: hit the ball「擊中球」：一開始完全打不到球。spend、hope、invite the ball 都不通。
until + 句子「直到…」：每天練到天黑。whether、than、during 都不通。
spend + 錢 + on + 物「花錢買…」。hit、heard、chose all her money on 都不通。
hope (that) …「希望…」：大家希望她能有所表現。spent、hit、invited 後面不能接句子。
be wrong about + 人「看錯某人」。least、likely、few about you 都不通。

passages.zh: Mia 是校棒球隊裡唯一的女生。一開始，她完全打不到球。有些男生笑她：「棒球不是女生玩的。」Mia 沒有理他們。她每天放學後都練習到天黑，甚至把所有零用錢都花在一支新球棒上。在決賽中，我們以 2 比 3 落後，輪到 Mia 打擊。大家都希望她能做點什麼。Mia 把球打出了圍牆，我們贏了比賽！那些笑過她的男生是第一批衝向她的人。「我們看錯你了。」他們說。

passages.title: 小木偶的長鼻子
passages.text: Pinocchio is a wooden boy. Every time he tells a lie, his nose grows longer. One day, his father asked {1} he had gone to school. "Yes," Pinocchio said. But that was a lie. In fact, he had {2} the whole day watching a puppet show. His nose grew so long that it {3} the lamp on the table. The lamp fell to the floor. "I think you said something {4}," his father said, but he was not angry. "I just {5} you can tell me the truth." Pinocchio cried and said sorry. Then his nose became short again. From that day on, he never lied to his father.

blanks.why: ask whether …「問是否…」：爸爸問他有沒有去上學。until、than、during 都不能接在 asked 後面表示「問…」。
spend + 時間 + V-ing「花時間做…」：他整天都在看木偶戲。hit、heard、invited the whole day 都不通。
hit「撞到、打到」：鼻子長到撞到桌上的燈。heard、hoped、chose the lamp 都不通。
say something wrong「說錯話、說了不對的話」。something least、something few、something every 都不通。
I hope (that) …「我希望…」。spend、hit、invite 後面不能接句子。

gloss: 小木偶皮諾丘（童話角色）
passages.zh: 皮諾丘是一個木頭做的男孩，他每說一次謊，鼻子就會變長。有一天，爸爸問他有沒有去上學。「有啊。」皮諾丘說。但那是謊話。事實上，他整天都在看木偶戲。他的鼻子長到撞到了桌上的燈，燈掉到了地上。「我想你說了不對的話。」爸爸說，但他並沒有生氣。「我只希望你能跟我說實話。」皮諾丘哭著道歉，鼻子又變短了。從那天起，他再也沒有對爸爸說過謊。

passages.title: 奶奶的助聽器
passages.text: My grandma is eighty, and she can't {1} very well. When we talk to her, we have to speak loudly. Sometimes she still gets our words {2}. Last week, I said, "Grandma, I'm hungry." She said, "You're angry? Why?" We all laughed, but Mom was worried. She took Grandma to see a doctor. The doctor told her to {3} a hearing aid. Grandma was not sure {4} she wanted one. "I'm too old for new things," she said. But she agreed to try it for at {5} one week. On the first morning, she sat by the window with a big smile. "I can hear the birds again!" she said. Now she wears it every day.

blanks.why: can't hear well「聽不太清楚」。hit、spend、invite very well 都不合句意。
get … wrong「把…弄錯、聽錯」：奶奶把 hungry 聽成 angry。least、likely、few 都不通。
choose a hearing aid「挑選助聽器」。hit、hope、spend a hearing aid 都不通。
be not sure whether …「不確定是否…」。until、than、during 都不通。
at least「至少」：同意至少試一個星期。at lot、at few、at same 都不是片語。

passages.zh: 我奶奶八十歲了，耳朵不太聽得清楚。我們跟她說話時要很大聲，有時候她還是會聽錯。上星期我說：「奶奶，我餓了。」她說：「你生氣了？為什麼？」大家都笑了，但媽媽很擔心，帶奶奶去看醫生。醫生要她去挑一副助聽器。奶奶不確定自己要不要。「我太老了，不適合新東西。」她說。但她答應至少試戴一個星期。第一天早上，她坐在窗邊，笑得好開心：「我又聽得到鳥叫聲了！」現在她每天都戴著。

passages.title: 樓上的鋼琴聲
passages.text: Every night, I could {1} piano music from the apartment upstairs. At first, I was angry because I couldn't sleep. One night, the music didn't stop {2} eleven o'clock. I went upstairs to complain. A girl about my age opened the door. "I'm so sorry," she said. "I have a big piano contest next week, and I {3} to win first place." I suddenly felt bad. I told her she played very well. She smiled and {4} me to her contest. On the day of the contest, I sat in the front row. She won second place, and she was very happy. Now she stops practicing at nine every night. On Fridays, she even lets me {5} a song for her to play.

blanks.why: hear music「聽到音樂」：每晚聽到樓上的鋼琴聲。hit、spend、choose piano music from upstairs 都不通。
not … until …「直到…才…」：音樂到十一點才停。whether、than、during 都不通。
hope to + 原形動詞「希望做…」：希望拿第一名。hit、spend、invite to win 都不通。
invite + 人 + to + 活動「邀請某人來…」。hit、heard、spent me to her contest 都不通。
choose a song「選一首歌」：讓我選歌給她彈。hit、spend、hope a song 都不通。

passages.zh: 每天晚上，我都會聽到樓上公寓傳來鋼琴聲。一開始我很生氣，因為我睡不著。有一天晚上，琴聲到十一點都還沒停，我就上樓去抱怨。開門的是一個跟我差不多大的女孩。「真的很抱歉，」她說，「我下星期有一場重要的鋼琴比賽，我希望能拿第一名。」我突然覺得很不好意思，告訴她她彈得很好。她笑了，還邀請我去看她的比賽。比賽那天，我坐在第一排。她得了第二名，非常開心。現在她每天晚上九點就停止練琴。每個星期五，她甚至讓我選一首歌給她彈。

passages.title: 存錢買遊戲機
passages.text: I wanted a new game machine, but Mom said I had to pay for it myself. It cost 9,000 dollars. "I will never save that much," I said. "You can, if you don't {1} your money on snacks," Mom said. So I made a plan. I saved my pocket money every week and didn't buy any drinks. I also helped my uncle wash his car on weekends. It was hard. My friends often {2} me to go to the movies, but I always said no. I kept saving {3} the summer vacation. Finally, I had {4} money. When I bought the machine, it felt different. I worked hard for it, so I enjoyed it even more. I {5} my little brother can learn this lesson, too.

blanks.why: spend + 錢 + on + 物「把錢花在…」。hit、hear、invite your money on snacks 都不通。
invite + 人 + to + 原形動詞「邀請某人做…」。hoped、heard、spent me to go 都不通。
until + 時間「一直到…」：一直存到暑假。whether、than、during 都不合句意。
enough money「足夠的錢」。likely、wrong、kind 都不能這樣形容錢。
I hope (that) …「我希望…」。spend、hit、invite 後面不能接句子。

passages.zh: 我想要一台新的遊戲機，但媽媽說要我自己出錢。它要價 9,000 元。「我永遠存不到那麼多錢啦。」我說。「可以的，只要你不把錢花在零食上。」媽媽說。於是我訂了計畫：每週把零用錢存起來，一杯飲料都不買，週末還幫舅舅洗車。真的很辛苦。朋友常邀我去看電影，我都說不。我一直存到暑假，終於存夠錢了。買到遊戲機的那一刻，感覺很不一樣。因為是我努力換來的，所以玩得更開心。我希望弟弟也能學到這個道理。

passages.title: 要不要養狗
passages.text: My family couldn't decide {1} to get a dog. My sister and I really wanted one, but Dad said, "A dog needs a lot of care. Who will walk it every day?" "We will!" we said. Dad didn't believe us, so he made a plan. For one month, we had to take care of our neighbor's dog, Lucky, while she was away. We got up early every day to walk Lucky, even when it was raining. One morning, I chose the {2} road, and we got lost for an hour. When we finally got home, I {3} Lucky bark happily. At the end of the month, Dad asked, "Do you still want a dog?" We said yes. So we {4} the next weekend at an animal shelter and {5} a little brown dog.

blanks.why: decide whether to …「決定要不要…」。until、than、during 後面不能接 to + 原形動詞。
choose the wrong road「走錯路」，所以迷路了。least、likely、few 都不通。
hear + 動物 + 原形動詞「聽到…叫」。hit、spent、invited Lucky bark 都不通。
spend + 時間 + at + 地方「在某地度過…」。hit、heard、invited the next weekend 都不通。
choose a dog「挑一隻狗」。hit、heard、spent a little brown dog 都不通。

passages.zh: 我們家一直無法決定要不要養狗。我和妹妹很想養，但爸爸說：「養狗要花很多心力照顧，誰要每天帶牠散步？」「我們！」我們說。爸爸不相信，所以他想了一個計畫：鄰居出門的一個月裡，我們要幫她照顧她的狗 Lucky。我們每天早起帶 Lucky 散步，下雨天也一樣。有一天早上，我走錯路，我們迷路了一個小時。終於回到家時，我聽到 Lucky 開心地叫。一個月結束時，爸爸問：「你們還想養狗嗎？」我們說想。於是我們下個週末去了動物收容所，挑了一隻棕色的小狗。

passages.title: 聽錯的作文題目
passages.text: Our English teacher asked us to write about "My Hero." But I didn't {1} her clearly. I thought she said "My Hair." That night, I {2} two hours writing about my hair: how I wash it, how I cut it, and why I hate it on rainy days. The next day, I read my story in front of the class. Everyone laughed. "I think you got the topic {3}," the teacher said. My face turned red. I was not sure {4} she would give me a zero. But she said, "This is the funniest story I have read this year. You can write about your hero next week." Since then, I always listen carefully {5} the teacher finishes talking.

blanks.why: hear + 人 + clearly「聽清楚某人說話」。hit、spend、invite her clearly 都不通。
spend + 時間 + V-ing「花時間做…」。hit、heard、invited two hours writing 都不通。
get the topic wrong「把題目弄錯」。least、likely、few 都不通。
be not sure whether …「不確定會不會…」。until、than、during 都不通。
until + 句子「直到…」：專心聽到老師講完。whether、than、during 在這裡都不合句意或文法。

passages.zh: 英文老師要我們寫〈我的英雄〉。但我沒聽清楚，以為她說的是〈我的頭髮〉。那天晚上，我花了兩個小時寫我的頭髮：我怎麼洗、怎麼剪，還有為什麼下雨天我最討厭它。隔天，我在全班面前唸我的作文，大家都笑了。「我想你把題目弄錯了。」老師說。我的臉都紅了，不知道她會不會給我零分。但她說：「這是我今年讀過最好笑的作文。你下星期再寫你的英雄吧。」從那之後，我都會專心聽到老師把話說完。

passages.title: 一個人吃午餐的轉學生
passages.text: A new student, Kenji, came to our class from Japan. He didn't speak much Chinese, so he always ate lunch alone. One day, I {1} to sit next to him. I didn't know {2} he could understand English, but I tried. "Do you like basketball?" I asked. His eyes lit up. "Yes! I love it!" After school, I {3} him to play with my friends. He was really good. Almost every shot went in. Even when the ball {4} the edge of the basket, it still dropped in. My friends couldn't believe it. Now Kenji is one of my best friends. We {5} every lunch break together, and he is teaching me some Japanese.

blanks.why: choose to + 原形動詞「選擇做…」。hit、heard、spent 後面不能接 to sit。
don't know whether …「不知道是否…」。until、than、during 都不通。
invite + 人 + to + 原形動詞「邀請某人來做…」。hoped、heard、spent him to play 都不通。
hit「撞到」：球打到籃框邊緣還是進了。heard、chose、invited the edge 都不通。
spend + 時間 + together「一起度過…」。hit、hear、invite every lunch break 都不通。

passages.zh: 一位新同學健二從日本轉來我們班。他中文說得不多，所以總是一個人吃午餐。有一天，我選擇坐到他旁邊。我不知道他聽不聽得懂英文，但還是試了一下。「你喜歡籃球嗎？」我問。他的眼睛一亮：「喜歡！我超愛！」放學後，我邀他和我朋友一起打球。他真的很厲害，幾乎每球都進。就算球打到籃框邊緣，最後還是掉進去，朋友們都不敢相信。現在健二是我最好的朋友之一。我們每天午休都待在一起，他還在教我說一點日語。

passages.title: 給導師的離別禮物
passages.text: Our homeroom teacher, Ms. Lin, is leaving our school at the end of the year. Our class wanted to {1} a special gift for her. Some students wanted to buy flowers. Others wanted to give her a cake. "But flowers die, and a cake is gone in one day," said Amy. "We need something she can keep." So we decided not to {2} any money. Instead, each of us wrote her a letter, and we put all the letters into a book. We kept it a secret {3} the last day of school. On that day, we {4} her to the music room. When she opened the book, she started to cry. "This is the best gift in the world," she said. "I {5} you will all write to me again one day."

blanks.why: choose a gift「挑選禮物」。hit、hear、hope a special gift 都不通。
spend money「花錢」：決定不花錢，改寫信。hit、hear、invite any money 都不通。
until + 時間「一直到…」：一直保密到最後一天。whether、than、during 都不通。
invite + 人 + to + 地方「邀請某人到…」。hoped、heard、spent her to the music room 都不通。
I hope (that) …「我希望…」。spend、hit、invite 後面不能接句子。

passages.zh: 我們的導師林老師學期末就要離開學校了。我們班想挑一份特別的禮物給她。有人想買花，有人想送蛋糕。「可是花會謝，蛋糕一天就吃完了，」Amy 說，「我們需要她可以留著的東西。」於是我們決定一毛錢都不花，改成每個人寫一封信給她，再把所有信做成一本書。我們一直保密到學期最後一天。那天，我們邀請老師到音樂教室。她打開那本書時，哭了出來。「這是世界上最棒的禮物，」她說，「希望有一天你們都會再寫信給我。」

passages.title: 啄木鳥不會頭痛嗎
passages.text: Woodpeckers are amazing birds. They {1} trees with their beaks up to 20 times a second. Why don't they get headaches? For many years, people thought woodpeckers had something soft in their heads, like a pillow. But a new study says this idea is {2}. Their heads are hard like hammers, and their brains are very small, so the hits don't hurt them. Woodpeckers make holes in trees to find food. Some scientists think they can even {3} insects moving inside the wood! They also make holes for their homes. A woodpecker can {4} about two weeks making one nest. So next time you are in a forest and hear a "knock, knock" sound, look up. You may see at {5} one of these busy birds.

blanks.why: hit「敲、撞擊」：啄木鳥用嘴敲樹。hear、hope、invite trees 都不通。
be wrong「是錯的」：新研究說這個想法是錯的。least、few、every 都不能放在 is 後面。
hear + 受詞 + V-ing「聽到…正在…」：聽到蟲在木頭裡動。spend、invite、hope insects moving 都不通。
spend + 時間 + V-ing「花時間做…」。hit、hear、invite about two weeks 都不通。
at least「至少」：至少會看到一隻。at lot、at few、at same 都不是片語。

passages.zh: 啄木鳥是很神奇的鳥。牠們用嘴敲樹，一秒鐘最多可以敲 20 下。牠們為什麼不會頭痛呢？很多年來，人們以為啄木鳥頭裡有像枕頭一樣軟軟的東西。但一項新研究說這個想法是錯的。牠們的頭硬得像鐵鎚，腦又很小，所以敲擊不會傷到牠們。啄木鳥在樹上挖洞找食物，有些科學家認為牠們甚至聽得到蟲在木頭裡爬動！牠們也會挖洞當家，一隻啄木鳥大約要花兩個星期才能做好一個巢。所以下次你在森林裡聽到「叩、叩」的聲音，抬頭看看，你也許至少會看到一隻忙碌的啄木鳥。

passages.title: 下山走錯路
passages.text: Last summer, my dad and I went hiking on a mountain. On the way down, we took the {1} path. Soon we were lost. The sky was getting dark, and my phone had no signal. Dad told me to stay calm. "We will walk slowly {2} we find the main path," he said. We walked for an hour. I was tired and scared. I {3} someone would find us. Then we {4} a dog barking. A farmer and his dog were coming down the hill. He showed us the way to his house and {5} us to have dinner with his family. That night, we ate the best rice I had ever had. Now, I always check the map before I go hiking.

blanks.why: take the wrong path「走錯路」，所以迷路了。least、likely、kind 都不能這樣用。
until + 句子「直到…」：慢慢走，直到找到主要步道。whether、than、during 都不通。
hope (that) …「希望…」：希望有人找到我們。hit、spent、invited 後面不能接句子。
hear + 動物 + V-ing「聽到…在叫」。hit、spent、chose a dog barking 都不通。
invite + 人 + to + 原形動詞「邀請某人做…」。hoped、heard、spent us to have dinner 都不通。

passages.zh: 去年夏天，我和爸爸去爬山。下山時，我們走錯了路，很快就迷路了。天色漸漸變暗，我的手機也沒有訊號。爸爸要我保持冷靜：「我們慢慢走，直到找到主要步道。」我們走了一個小時，我又累又怕，只希望有人能找到我們。這時我們聽到狗叫聲，一位農夫帶著他的狗從山坡上走下來。他帶我們到他家，還邀請我們和他的家人一起吃晚餐。那天晚上，我們吃到了這輩子最好吃的米飯。現在，我每次去爬山之前都會先看地圖。
